install.title: Install MCP
install.description: Connect this workspace's mock API tools to your AI client. Pick one of the two methods below.
install.step1: The MCP server runs locally. Clone this project's repository and run npm install first.
install.step2: Replace the path placeholder in the config below with the absolute path of your cloned monorepo.

json.title: Method 1. Paste the config JSON
json.description: Paste the block below into the settings file of the MCP client you use.
json.windowsPathNote: In JSON, Windows paths need doubled backslashes (C:\\Users\\me\\repo) or forward slashes (C:/Users/me/repo).

cli.title: Method 2. Claude Code CLI
cli.description: Run the command below in your terminal. The config is stored only in your personal file (~/.claude.json), so the API key never lands in the repository.

install.note: The config is filled with the API address of the environment you are currently connected to.

apiKey.reissueSuccess: Your API key has been reissued.
apiKey.reissueDialogDescription: Reissue your API key? The current key is revoked immediately and your own MCP integration stops working. Other members are unaffected.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: After installation, ask the AI in natural language and the tools below are used automatically. All items are addressed by path (e.g. /shop/users).

codeOptions.title: Code generation options
codeOptions.description: When you ask for code, the AI asks these options (supported clients show a picker) or skips any you already specified.

create_mock_api.desc: Generate mock data from a schema, create a mock API, and return the URL
create_mock_api.example: Create a products mock API with id, name, price fields, 10 items.

create_folder.desc: Create a folder for mock APIs (intermediate folders included)

list_mock_apis.desc: List folders and mock APIs by path
list_mock_apis.example: What's in this workspace right now?

describe_mock_api.desc: Inspect the stored schema, enabled options, faker settings, and current data
describe_mock_api.example: What does the products schema look like now?

update_mock_api.desc: Regenerate a mock API's schema and data by path (name/location kept)
update_mock_api.example: Add an email field to the products schema and update it.

rename_mock_api.desc: Rename an item by path (URL path is recomputed)

move_mock_api.desc: Move an item to another folder by path
move_mock_api.example: Move users into the shop folder.

delete_mock_api.desc: Delete an item by path (folders include children)

reset_mock_state.desc: Discard runtime edits made through the mock server and restore the original data

get_api_code.example: Give me products integration code in ts, fetch+query, zod.
